name: PayPeriodCalendarPeriod
description: Organization-scoped explicit payroll period for a custom-calendar PayPeriodSchedule. Periods are resolved server-side and preserved on Time Cards for historical accuracy.

pay_period_schedule_id.description: PayPeriodSchedule.id that owns this explicit period.

schedule_version.description: Version of the payroll schedule when this calendar period was created.

period_start.description: Inclusive first date of the payroll period.

period_end.description: Inclusive final date of the payroll period.

period_key.description: Unique organization-scoped payroll-period key generated server-side.

is_active.description: False when the period is retired or replaced before use.

created_by_user_id.description: Administrator User.id that created the explicit period.

retired_at.description: Timestamp when this explicit period was retired.

retired_by_user_id.description: Administrator User.id that retired this explicit period.
